decode.scene_logic: desk because the product fixes evenings at the desk. decode.visual_trick: same camera angle for both halves, the bottom half warmer and tidier — copy literally
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: the glass of water next to the Goli bottle ↔ OUR glass of water with the tablet fizzing (template already has the glass: keep it, make it ours)
decode.render_style: photoreal, moody desk lamp light top, warm morning light bottom, shallow depth of field
decode.text_treatment: white bold sans headline (3 lines), white regular 2-line subline, yellow rounded button with dark text and an arrow → Edenvia accent blue button with white text

strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs — your leg-swelling routine is letting you down
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: the nightly ritual of socks, tea and legs up the wall · cause: none of it reaches the inflamed tissue · tried: compression, teas, dry brushing, elevating
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
